rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「장애아동 복지지원법」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on Welfare Support for Children with Disabilities and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(중앙장애아동지원센터의 설치ㆍ운영) ① 「장애아동 복지지원법」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제8조제1항에 따른 중앙장애아동지원센터(이하 “중앙장애아동지원센터”라 한다)의 장은 법 제8조제1항 각 호의 업무를 적절하게 수행할 수 있는 전담 인력을 배치하고, 그 업무의 수행에 필요한 독립된 공간을 확보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Establishment and Operation of the Central Support Center for Children with Disabilities) ① The head of the Central Support Center for Children with Disabilities (hereinafter referred to as the “Central Support Center for Children with Disabilities”) pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the “Act on Support for Welfare of Children with Disabilities” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall assign dedicated personnel capable of appropriately performing the duties set forth in each subparagraph of Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act , and secure an independent space necessary for the performance of such duties.
② Deleted <January 22, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제3조(지역장애아동지원센터의 설치기준과 운영 등) ① 법 제9조제1항에 따라 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도시자ㆍ특별자치도지사가 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도에 설치하는 지역장애아동지원센터의 설치ㆍ운영 기준 및 직원의 자격ㆍ배치 기준은 별표 6과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Standards for Establishment and Operation, etc. of Regional Support Centers for Children with Disabilities) ① The standards for the establishment and operation of regional support centers for children with disabilities and the standards for the qualifications and placement of staff established by the Mayor of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, City Governor, or Special Self-Governing Province Governor in a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, or Special Self-Governing Province pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 6 .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도에 설치하는 지역장애아동지원센터 운영에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the operation of regional support centers for children with disabilities established in special cities, metropolitan cities, special autonomous cities, provinces, and special autonomous provinces shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: ③ 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다)이 법 제9조제1항에 따라 시ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구를 말한다. 이하 같다)에 지역장애아동지원센터를 설치하는 경우에는 그 조직과 운영에 필요한 사항은 해당 시ㆍ군ㆍ구의 조례로 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where a mayor, county governor, or district head (referring to the head of an autonomous district) establishes a local support center for children with disabilities in a city, county, or district (referring to an autonomous district; hereinafter the same applies) pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act, matters necessary for the organization and operation thereof shall be determined by the ordinance of the relevant city, county, or district .
[Wholly Amended Dec. 19, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(복지지원의 신청 방법 및 절차) ① 법 제13조제1항에 따라 복지지원을 신청하려는 사람은 사회복지서비스 및 급여 제공(변경) 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 첨부하여 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(자치구의 구청장을 말한다. 이하 같다)에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2012. 8. 31., 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Method and Procedure for Applying for Welfare Support) ① Any person who intends to apply for welfare support pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for the provision (change) of social welfare services and benefits, attached with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including electronic documents), to the competent Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, Mayor, County Head, or Head of a District (referring to the head of an autonomous district; hereinafter the same applies). <Amended Aug. 31, 2012; Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.text_en: 1. Income and Asset Declaration Form

rows.source_ko: 2. 월급명세서 또는 매출신고서 등 소득ㆍ재산을 확인할 수 있는 서류[해당 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구(자치구를 말한다. 이하 같다) 소속 공무원이 그 내용을 확인할 수 없는 경우나 신청서의 기재사항과 공부(公簿)상의 내용이 다른 경우만 해당한다]
rows.text_en: 2. Documents capable of verifying income and assets, such as pay slips or sales reports [Applicable only to cases where a public official belonging to the relevant Special Self-Governing City, Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District (referring to an autonomous district; hereinafter the same) cannot verify the contents, or where the details stated in the application differ from the contents in public records]

rows.text_en: 3. Consent form for the provision of financial information, credit information, and insurance information (hereinafter referred to as “financial information, etc.”) under Article 13, Paragraph 2 , Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of the Act [including consent forms of household members]

rows.source_ko: 4. 복지지원을 신청하려는 사람의 신분을 확인할 수 있는 서류로서 다음 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 서류

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 신청인의 가족관계등록부를 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하도록 해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head who receives an application under Paragraph 1 shall verify the applicant's family relationship register through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant documents. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(복지지원 제공기관과의 연계) 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제16조제1항에 따라 복지지원 대상자로 선정한 장애아동 및 그 가족과 복지지원 제공기관을 연계할 때에는 해당 장애아동 및 그 가족의 의사를 반영하도록 노력해야 하며, 법 제17조제1항에 따른 개인별지원계획이 최대한 달성될 수 있도록 노력해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Linkage with Welfare Support Providers) When linking a child with a disability and their family selected as a beneficiary of welfare support pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Act with a welfare support provider , the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall endeavor to reflect the wishes of the said child with a disability and their family, and shall endeavor to ensure that the individual support plan pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act is achieved to the maximum extent possible. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(개인별지원계획의 수립) ① 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제17조제1항에 따른 개인별지원계획을 수립할 때에는 장애아동과 그 가족의 의견을 들을 수 있다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Establishment of Individual Support Plans) ① The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Headmay hear the opinions of a child with a disability and their family when establishing an individual support plan pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act . <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제17조제1항에 따른 개인별지원계획은 별지 제1호서식에 따라 매년 작성하여야 한다. 이 경우 장애아동의 특성 및 복지 욕구, 복지지원 제공기관에 관한 세부 내용, 복지지원의 내용 및 방법과 관련하여 필요한 내용을 추가할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The individual support plan pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be prepared annually in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto . In this case, necessary details regarding the characteristics and welfare needs of the disabled child, the details regarding the welfare support provider, and the content and methods of welfare support may be added.

rows.source_ko: ③ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제17조제1항 후단에 따라 개인별지원계획의 수립 업무를 위탁한 경우에는 위탁받은 지역장애아동지원센터의 장에게 복지지원 대상자로 선정된 장애아동을 통보해야 하고, 통보를 받은 지역장애아동지원센터의 장은 통보받은 날부터 30일 이내에 개인별지원계획을 수립해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ③ Where the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head has entrusted the task of establishing individual support plans pursuant to the latter part of Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they shall notify the head of the entrusted Regional Support Center for Children with Disabilities of children with disabilities who has been selected as a recipient of welfare support, and the head of the Regional Support Center for Children with Disabilities who receives the notification shall establish an individual support plan within 30 days from the date of receiving the notification. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따라 지역장애아동지원센터의 장이 개인별지원계획을 수립할 때에는 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시하는 개인별지원계획의 수립 방법 및 절차 등에 적합하게 수립해야 한다. <신설 2025. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ④ When the head of a regional support center for children with disabilities establishes an individual support plan pursuant to Paragraph 3, he/ she shall establish it in accordance with the methods and procedures for establishing individual support plans prescribed and notified by the Minister of Health and Welfare . <Newly added Dec. 19, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제17조제2항에 따라 자문한 경우에는 그 내용을 대장에 기록하여 보관해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7., 2025. 12. 19.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Governor, or a District Head shall record and keep the contents of any advice provided pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Act in a ledger. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021; Dec. 19, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(발달재활서비스의 지원 기준 등) ① 보건복지부장관은 법 제21조제2항에 따라 발달재활서비스 지원의 필요성 및 효과, 장애아동 및 그 가족의 소득과 재산을 고려하여 매년 예산의 범위에서 발달재활서비스 지원 기준을 마련하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Standards for Support of Developmental Rehabilitation Services, etc.) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall, in accordance with Article 21, Paragraph 2 of the Act , establish standards for support of developmental rehabilitation services within the scope of the annual budget, taking into consideration the necessity and effectiveness of support for developmental rehabilitation services, and the income and assets of children with disabilities and their families.

rows.source_ko: ② 지방자치단체의 장은 제1항의 지원 기준에 따라 발달재활서비스 지원 대상 장애아동을 선정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of a local government shall select children with disabilities eligible for developmental rehabilitation services in accordance with the support criteria in Paragraph 1.
③ Deleted <December 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 지방자치단체의 장은 제2항에 따라 발달재활서비스를 지원할 때에는 장애아동 복지지원 이용권으로 제공할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ When the head of a local government provides developmental rehabilitation services pursuant to Paragraph 2, he/she may provide them in the form of welfare support vouchers for children with disabilities.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(발달재활서비스 제공기관의 지정기준 및 지정 절차) ① 법 제21조제4항에 따른 발달재활서비스 제공기관(이하 “발달재활서비스 제공기관”이라 한다)의 지정기준은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2015. 12. 31., 2021. 12. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Designation Criteria and Procedures for Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers) ①The designation criteria for developmental rehabilitation service providers pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 4 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers”) are as set forth in Attached Table 1. <Amended Dec. 31, 2015; Dec. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 발달재활서비스 제공기관으로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제2호서식의 발달재활서비스 제공기관 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2015. 12. 31., 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② Any person who intends to be designated as a provider of developmental rehabilitation services shall submit an application for designation as a provider of developmental rehabilitation services in the form of Annex 2, along with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Dec. 31, 2015; Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.text_en: 5. Documents proving the qualifications of the head of the developmental rehabilitation service provider and the developmental rehabilitation service personnel

rows.source_ko: ④ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 발달재활서비스 제공기관을 지정하려는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사람을 위원으로 하는 발달재활서비스 제공기관 심사위원회를 구성하여 제1항의 지정기준에 적합한지를 심사하게 해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ④ When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head intends to designate an institution providing developmental rehabilitation services, they shall constitute a Review Committee for Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers, composed of the persons specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to review whether the institution meets the designation criteria set forth in Paragraph 1. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도ㆍ시ㆍ군ㆍ구 소속의 관계 공무원 1명
rows.text_en: 1. One relevant public official belonging to the relevant Special Self-Governing City, Special Self-Governing Province, City, County, or District

rows.source_ko: 2. 장애아동 또는 발달재활서비스와 관련한 학식과 경험이 풍부한 사람 4명 이내
rows.text_en: 2. Up to 4 people with extensive knowledge and experience related to children with disabilities or developmental rehabilitation services

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 발달재활서비스 제공기관을 지정할 때에는 지역별 지원 대상 장애아동의 수와 지역 특성 등을 고려하여 적정한 수의 발달재활서비스 제공기관을 지정해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ When designating institutions providing developmental rehabilitation services, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall designate an appropriate number of such institutions, taking into consideration the number of disabled children eligible for support in each region and regional characteristics. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제5항에 따라 발달재활서비스 제공기관을 지정했을 때에는 보건복지부장관이 정하는 지정서를 발급해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head has designated a developmental rehabilitation service provider pursuant to Paragraph 5, they shall issue a certificate of designation prescribed by the Minister of Health and Welfare . <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제1항부터 제6항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 발달재활서비스 제공기관 심사위원회의 구성ㆍ운영 및 심사기준 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 정한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ Except for the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 6, necessary matters concerning the composition, operation, and evaluation standards, etc. of the Review Committee for Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers shall be determined by the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제8조의2(소방시설 등 확인 요청) ① 제8조제2항에 따라 지정 신청을 받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 발달재활서비스 제공기관이 별표 1 제1호다목에 따라 갖추어야 하는 소방시설 등에 대하여 「소방시설 설치 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제6조제8항 전단에 따라 그 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 소재지를 관할하는 소방본부장이나 소방서장에게 그 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 소방시설 등이 같은 법 또는 같은 법에 따른 명령을 따르고 있는지에 대한 확인을 요청해야 한다. 이 경우 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 소방시설 등을 확인할 수 있는 도면을 그 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 소재지를 관할하는 소방본부장이나 소방서장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2017. 9. 12., 2021. 9. 7., 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: Article 8-2 (Request for Verification of Firefighting Facilities, etc.) ①A Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Head, or District Head who has received an application for designation pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 , shall, in accordance with the first part of Article 6 , Paragraph 8 of the Act on the Installation and Management of Firefighting Facilities, request the Head of the Fire Headquarters or the Head of the Fire Station having jurisdiction over the location of said developmental rehabilitation service provider to verify whether the firefighting facilities, etc. required to be provided by said developmental rehabilitation service provider pursuant to Item 1, Subparagraph (c) of Annex 1, that such developmental rehabilitation service provider complies with the said Act or orders issued pursuant to the said Act . In this case, the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, Mayor, County Head, or District Head shall submit drawings capable of verifying the firefighting facilities, etc. to the Head of the Fire Headquarters or the Head of the Fire Station having jurisdiction over the location of said developmental rehabilitation service provider. <Amended Sep. 12, 2017; Sep. 7, 2021; Mar. 18, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 발달재활서비스 제공기관이 소재지를 옮기는 경우에 발달재활서비스 제공기관이 별표 1 제1호다목에 따라 갖추어야 하는 소방시설 등에 대하여 「소방시설 설치 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제6조제8항 전단에 따라 그 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 소재지를 관할하는 소방본부장이나 소방서장에게 그 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 소방시설 등이 같은 법 또는 같은 법에 따른 명령을 따르고 있는지에 대한 확인을 요청해야 한다. <개정 2017. 9. 12., 2021. 9. 7., 2024. 3. 18.>
rows.text_en: ② In the event that a developmental rehabilitation service provider relocates its address, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head shall, in accordance with the first part of Article 6, Paragraph 8 of the Act on the Installation and Management of Firefighting Facilities, request the Head of the Fire Headquarters or the Head of the Fire Station having jurisdiction over the location of the developmental rehabilitation service provider to verify whether the firefighting facilities, etc. of the developmental rehabilitation service provider comply with the said Act or orders issued pursuant to the said Act , with respect to the firefighting facilities, etc. that the developmental rehabilitation service provider must possess pursuant to Item 1, Subparagraph (c) of Annex 1. <Amended Sep. 12, 2017; Sep. 7, 2021; Mar. 18, 2024>
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(발달재활서비스 제공기관의 운영기준) 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 운영기준은 별표 2와 같다. <개정 2015. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Operational Standards for Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers) The operational standards for developmental rehabilitation service providersare as set forth in Attached Table 2. <Amended Dec. 31, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(발달재활서비스 제공기관의 지정취소) ① 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제21조제6항에 따라 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 지정을 취소하려는 경우에는 해당 발달재활서비스 제공기관에서 발달재활서비스를 이용 중인 장애아동을 다른 발달재활서비스 제공기관으로 옮기도록 하는 등 장애아동의 권익을 보호하기 위하여 필요한 조치를 해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7., 2021. 12. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Revocation of Designation of Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers) ① When the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head intends to revoke the designation of a developmental rehabilitation service provider pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 6 of the Act , they shall take necessary measures to protect the rights and interests of children with disabilities, such as transferring children with disabilities currently utilizing developmental rehabilitation services at the relevant provider to another developmental rehabilitation service provider. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021; Dec. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 지정을 취소한 경우 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사는 보건복지부장관에게, 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ도지사를 거쳐 보건복지부장관에게 보고해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② In the event that the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head revokes the designation of a developmental rehabilitation service provider, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City or the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province shall report to the Minister of Health and Welfare, and the Mayor, County Head, or District Head shall report to the Minister of Health and Welfare through the Mayor of a Special City, the Mayor of a Metropolitan City, or the Governor of a Province. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(발달재활서비스 제공기관의 지정기간) 법 제21조제8항에 따른 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 지정기간은 1년 이상 3년 이내의 범위에서 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 정한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7., 2021. 12. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Designation Period of Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers) The designation period of a developmental rehabilitation service provider pursuant to Article 21, Paragraph 8 of the Act shall be determined by the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head within a range of not less than one year and not more than three years. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021; Dec. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(특수교육 또는 재활 관련 교과목 및 학점 등) 「장애아동 복지지원법 시행령」 제5조제2항제2호에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 특수교육 또는 재활 관련 교과목 및 학점”이란 별표 3과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Subjects and credits related to special education or rehabilitation, etc.) In Article 5, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Support of Children with Disabilities, “subjects and credits related to special education or rehabilitation prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” are as set forth in Appendix 3 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(돌봄 서비스지원) ① 보건복지부장관은 법 제24조제2항에 따라 보호자의 질병이나 사회 활동 등으로 돌봄 서비스지원이 필요한 장애아동 중에서 소득과 재산을 고려하여 매년 예산의 범위에서 지원 기준을 마련하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Support for Care Services) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall, in accordance with Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Act , establish support criteria within the scope of the annual budget for children with disabilities who require support for care services due to their guardian's illness or social activities, taking into consideration their income and assets.

rows.source_ko: ② 지방자치단체의 장은 제1항의 지원 기준에 따라 돌봄 서비스지원 대상 장애아동을 선정하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of a local government shall select children with disabilities eligible for care service support in accordance with the support criteria in Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③ 지방자치단체의 장은 별표 4의 양성교육과정을 이수한 인력으로 하여금 법 제24조에 따른 돌봄 서비스를 제공하게 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of a local government shall have personnel who have completed the training course specified in Annex 4 provide care services pursuant to Article 24 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 제13조의2(장애아 돌보미의 자격 정지 기준) 법 제24조의4제1항에 따른 장애아 돌보미의 자격 정지 기준은 별표 5와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 13-2 (Criteria for Suspension of Qualification of Caregivers for Children with Disabilities) The criteria for suspension of qualification of caregivers for children with disabilities pursuant to Article 24-4, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Table 5 .
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 18, 2024]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(복지지원의 제공) 법 제28조제1항에 따라 제공하는 장애아동 복지지원 이용권의 제공 방법 및 관리 등에 관하여는 「사회서비스 이용 및 이용권 관리에 관한 법률」 제9조부터 제15조까지의 규정에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Provision of Welfare Support) The method of provision and management, etc. of welfare support vouchers for disabled children provided pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be in accordance with Articles 9 through 15 of the Act on the Use of Social Services and Management of Vouchers .

rows.source_ko: 제15조(복지지원 제공기관의 정보제공) 복지지원 제공기관은 법 제31조제3항에 따라 시설 현황, 복지지원 제공인력 현황, 복지지원의 내용 및 비용과 그 밖에 보건복지부장관이 정하는 장애아동 복지지원 관련 정보를 매년 지역장애아동지원센터에 제공하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Provision of Information by Welfare Support Providers) In accordance with Article 31, Paragraph 3 of the Act , welfare support providerswith information regarding the status of facilities, the status of welfare support personnel, the content and cost of welfare support, and other information related to welfare support for children with disabilities as determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare every year.
Article 16 Deleted <September 27, 2024>
Article 17 Deleted <September 27, 2024>
Article 18 Deleted <September 27, 2024>
Article 19 Deleted <September 27, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제20조(발달재활서비스 제공기관의 정보제공) ① 법 제33조제1항에 따른 정보를 제공해야 하는 발달재활서비스 제공 인력의 범위는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Provision of Information by Developmental Rehabilitation Service Providers) ① The scope of personnel providing developmental rehabilitation services who are required to provide information pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be determined according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 및 지역장애아동지원센터의 장에게 제공하는 경우: 해당 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 발달재활서비스 제공 인력 전부
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where provided to the competent Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, Mayor, County Head, District Head, and the head of a Regional Support Center for Children with Disabilities: All personnel providing developmental rehabilitation services at the relevant developmental rehabilitation service provider

rows.source_ko: 2. 발달재활서비스를 제공받으려는 장애아동 및 그 보호자에게 제공하는 경우: 해당 장애아동에게 발달재활서비스를 제공할 인력
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where developmental rehabilitation services are provided to a child with a disability and their guardian who intends to receive such services: Personnel to provide developmental rehabilitation services to the said child with a disability

rows.source_ko: ② 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 장은 법 제33조제1항의 정보를 별지 제6호서식에 따라 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기한까지 제공해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of a developmental rehabilitation service provider shall provide the information under Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form by the deadlines specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 관할 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장 및 지역장애아동지원센터의 장에게 제공하는 경우: 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 지정을 통보받은 날부터 15일 이내
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where provided to the competent Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, Mayor, County Head, District Head, and the head of a Regional Support Center for Children with Disabilities: Within 15 days from the date of notification of the designation of the developmental rehabilitation service provider.

rows.source_ko: 2. 발달재활서비스를 제공받으려는 장애아동 및 그 보호자에게 제공하는 경우: 해당 발달재활서비스 제공기관에서 발달재활서비스를 최초로 제공하기 전까지
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where developmental rehabilitation services are provided to a child with a disability and their guardian who intends to receive such services: Until the relevant developmental rehabilitation service provider first provides the developmental rehabilitation services.

rows.source_ko: ③ 발달재활서비스 제공기관의 장은 제2항에 따라 제공한 정보가 변경된 경우에는 지체 없이 그 변경 내용을 법 제33조제1항 각 호의 대상에게 알려야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the information provided pursuant to Paragraph 2 is changed, the head of the developmental rehabilitation service provider shall notify the subjects of each subparagraph of Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act of the details of the change without delay.

rows.source_ko: 제20조의2(현장조사서) 법 제35조제2항에서 “보건복지부령으로 정하는 사항이 기재된 서류”란 다음 각 호의 사항이 기재된 현장조사서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 20-2 (Field Investigation Report) In Article 35, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the phrase “document containing matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Health and Welfare” refers to a field investigation report containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 조사기간
rows.text_en: 1. Investigation Period

rows.source_ko: 2. 조사범위
rows.text_en: 2. Scope of Investigation

rows.source_ko: 3. 조사담당자
rows.text_en: 3. Investigator

rows.source_ko: 4. 관계법령
rows.text_en: 4. Relevant Laws and Regulations

rows.source_ko: 5. 제출자료
rows.text_en: 5. Submission Materials

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 해당 현장조사와 관련하여 필요한 사항

rows.source_ko: 제21조(이의신청의 방법 및 절차) ① 법 제38조제1항에 따라 이의신청을 하려는 사람은 이의신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Method and Procedure for Objection) ① Any person who intends to file an objection pursuant to Article 38, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an objection form, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head. <Amended Sep. 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 이의신청의 내용을 확인할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents verifying the contents of the objection

rows.source_ko: 2. 이의신청을 하려는 사람의 인적 사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류로서 제4조제1항제4호 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents capable of verifying the personal information of the person intending to file an objection, falling under any of the items of Article 4, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4.

rows.source_ko: 3. 위임장 및 대리인의 인적 사항을 확인할 수 있는 서류로서 제4조제1항제4호 각 목의 어느 하나에 해당하는 서류(신청을 대리하는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. A power of attorney and documents verifying the personal details of the agent, falling under any of the items of Article 4, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 (only applicable when acting as an agent for the application)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 이의신청서를 접수받은 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사ㆍ시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 이의신청서를 접수한 날부터 15일 이내에 이의 신청을 각하 또는 기각하거나 처분을 취소 또는 변경하는 결정을 하고, 신청인에게 서면으로 그 결과를 통지해야 한다. 다만, 소득ㆍ재산의 조사 또는 장애 정도의 재심사를 하는 데 시일이 필요한 특별한 사유가 있는 경우에는 60일 이내에 결정ㆍ통지할 수 있으며, 이 경우 통지서에 그 사유를 적어야 한다. <개정 2019. 6. 4., 2021. 9. 7.>
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, a Mayor, a County Head, or a District Head who has received an objection form pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall, within 15 days from the date of receipt of the objection form, make a decision to dismiss or reject the objection or to cancel or modify the disposition, and notify the applicant of the result in writing. However, if there are special circumstances requiring time for an investigation of income or assets or a re-examination of the degree of disability, the decision and notification may be made within 60 days, and in such case, the reason shall be stated in the notification. <Amended June 4, 2019; September 7, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제22조(공통서식) 제4조제1항에 따른 사회복지서비스 및 급여 제공(변경) 신청서, 소득ㆍ재산신고서 및 금융정보등의 제공동의서, 제20조의2에 따른 현장조사서 및 제21조에 따른 이의신청서는 사회보장급여와 관련하여 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시하는 공통서식에 따른다. <개정 2016. 5. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Common Forms) The application for provision (change) of social welfare services and benefits pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 , the declaration of income and assets and the consent form for the provision of financial information, etc., the on-site investigation report pursuant to Article 20-2 , and the application for objection pursuant to Article 21 shall be in accordance with the common forms prescribed and notified by the Minister of Health and Welfare in relation to social security benefits . <Amended May 25, 2016>

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Designation of Childcare Centers for Children with Disabilities)  Childcare centers dedicated to children with disabilities and integrated childcare centers for children with disabilities that are established and operating in accordance with Article 9 of the Enforcement Rule of the Infant Care Act at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been designated as specialized childcare centers for children with disabilities and integrated childcare centers for children with disabilities, respectively, in accordance with Article 17, provided that they meet the requirements under Article 32, Paragraph 2 of the Act and Article 16 of this Rule by March 1, 2016.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(장애아동 재활치료 서비스 제공기관에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 장애아동 재활치료 서비스 제공기관으로 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장이 지정한 기관은 제8조제5항에 따라 발달재활서비스 제공기관으로 지정된 것으로 보되, 2013년 1월 31일까지 별표 1에 따른 지정기준을 갖추어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Institutions Providing Rehabilitation Treatment Services for Children with Disabilities)  Institutions designated by the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head as institutions providing rehabilitation treatment services for children with disabilities at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been designated as institutions providing developmental rehabilitation services pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 5, provided that they meet the designation criteria set forth in Annex 1 by January 31, 2013.
